title: Asharden Camp — Intake Notice
location: General Access Terminal — Asharden Camp, Upper City Edge
author: Camp Administration — Volunteer Staff
content:
ASHARDEN CAMP — NOTICE TO NEW ARRIVALS

If you arrived on Theev without enough money to stay in the Upper City and without enough fight to survive in the Lower City, you are probably standing in front of this terminal.

We can provide:
— Bunk space (shared)
— One meal per day
— Basic medical (very basic)
— A locked box for valuables (the lock is not reliable; we are honest about this)

We cannot provide:
— Safety in the lower city after you leave here
— Passage offworld (we have been trying to arrange this for some residents for a long time)
— Any influence over the gangs, the Widows, or anyone with actual power

Note: Some residents of this camp have accepted work arrangements offered by Lower City operators. This is a choice. We do not recommend it. We have seen where it leads. We document it anyway because documentation is what we have.

If someone offers you work and it sounds too simple, it is not simple.

—

Standing bounty on the administrative board: A contract has been posted by an anonymous party in the Cliff District offering Cr 40,000 plus fuel for a one-week offworld job requiring an independent ship and a crew willing to ask no questions. Interested parties inquire at the administrative booth. The administrator does not know the nature of the work. The administrator is open about not knowing.

—

[Handwritten on the terminal casing, not in the file:]

Vii Lon is gone from the camp. She left before second bell last night carrying a small bag and nothing else. We don't know where she went. If you see her, she is not dangerous and she is not lying about her situation. Be kind. Or at least be useful.

title: Asharden Camp — Resident Testimonials (Selected)
location: General Access Terminal — Asharden Camp, Upper City Edge
author: Camp Volunteer — Collected oral histories
content:
We ask residents to share their story if they want to. Some do. This is a selection.

—

'I came on a salvage contract. The company that hired us doesn't exist anymore. I don't know what happened to it. I know that we recovered something from a derelict in the Reach that our employer was very excited about and that three days later the employer stopped answering communications. Whatever it was they found, I don't have it anymore. Someone took it from the cargo lock while we were docked. I didn't see who.' — Similar recovered material documented: [[connect: scrapheap]]

—

'I used to work for a research outfit. I signed too many agreements to say who. We were working on recovered materials. Old stuff. Alien, maybe, or just very old human — nobody could agree. There was a fragment. Looked like black glass but heavier and it ran warm and it made the electronics in the lab do strange things. They shut the project down and fired everyone and I ended up here. I think about that fragment a lot. I think someone else has it now. I hope they know to be careful with it.'

—

'I came here on a contract with the Tobia Commerce Guild. There were four of us. I'm the only one who walked out of that hotel room. I never saw who came in the door. I was in the other room when it happened. By the time I came out, nothing was moving.

I filed the paperwork. The company said they'd get back to me. They haven't. The embassy said they'd look into it. They haven't either. My name is Vii Lon. If someone with a ship is reading this and you have a few hundred credits of goodwill to spare, I'm trying to get off this world. I can pay a little. I can work. I would rather not be here when whoever that was decides they missed one.' — Widow field report on the assault attempt: [[connect: lower_city]]

—

[Final entry, no name, handwritten after the typed record:]

'I am not here by accident. I will not say more than that in a public terminal.'

title: Murghen Consortium — Services and Rates
location: General Access Terminal — Cliff District, Upper City
author: Murghen Consortium — Johanna Murghen, Commander
content:
THE MURGHEN CONSORTIUM — PROFESSIONAL MILITARY SOLUTIONS

We are based on Theev. We have been based on Theev for eleven years. We have approximately nine hundred trained personnel and our own vessels. We do not ask questions about the target. We do not ask questions about the employer. We ask questions about payment.

Minimum contract: eight weeks.
Service types available: escort, assault, boarding, garrison, extraction, suppression, and a category we list as 'resolution' which means we will handle things that other firms decline to put in writing.

We do not accept contracts against the Widows, against the Skull's orbital infrastructure, or against parties currently under formal protection of the three major gangs simultaneously. Everything else is a matter of price.

—

Note from the Commander: We recently completed a contract for a party that I am not at liberty to name, involving recovery of a sealed container from a vessel in deep Reach space. The container was recovered. It was not opened by my personnel. Whatever is in it is the client's business. I mention this only because the client has not yet collected, and the container is starting to cause minor equipment malfunctions in the storage bay where it is being held.

If the client is reading this: please come and get your property.

Soon.

— For context on similar field effects: [[connect: scrapheap]]

title: Old Trade Records — Sindalian Empire Era (Fragment)
location: General Access Terminal — Cliff District, Upper City
date: ORIGINAL: PRE-COLLAPSE — RECOVERED AND FILED APPROX. 30 YEARS PRIOR
author: Sindalian Imperial Trade Office — Trojan Reach Division (Archived Fragment)
content:
TRADE MANIFEST — PARTIAL RECOVERY

Note from archivist: This fragment was recovered from a cache in the Cliff District. Origin unknown. The original document dates to the Sindalian period. We are filing it as a curiosity. Some of it is intact.

—

[LEGIBLE SECTION:]

Lot 7: Three units of mineral origin, unclassified. Recovered from a site in the outer Reach. Described by recovery team as 'dark, semi-reflective, of uniform internal composition.' Biological activity: none detected. Weight: inconsistent with apparent volume. The scales read a different number each time.

Delivered to: [NAME REDACTED — original document damage]

Note from recovery team: The units were found alongside what appeared to be structural remnants of a much larger object. The site itself showed no geological explanation for the composition of the surrounding material. The recovery team's engineer described the site as 'a scar, like something hit this place from a very great height, a very long time ago.' We are filing this for the record.

[ILLEGIBLE SECTION — document damage]

[FINAL LEGIBLE LINE:]

'The devices in the hold kept losing calibration. We reset them four times in one day. The engineer says this is not possible. The engineer is usually right about things.'

—

[Filed note, modern hand:]

Whoever these materials ended up with, it wasn't the Empire for long. The collapse took everything. But things like this have a way of turning up again eventually.

— A recovered hull with matching anomalous properties: [[connect: scrapheap]]

title: Widow Network Internal — Anomalous Signal Report
location: General Access Terminal — Blacksand Downport (Deep Partition)
author: Widow Administrative Office — Signals Division
content:
ANOMALOUS SIGNAL REPORT — INTERNAL USE ONLY

This file should not be accessible from any external terminal. If you are reading it, we have a problem.

—

A repeating signal was detected approximately three months ago originating from inside Blacksand City.

The signal does not match any known communication protocol.

It is not in any language we have on file.

It repeats at irregular intervals — between nine and forty-three minutes. The intervals do not follow a mathematical pattern we can identify.

The signal source has been triangulated to the lower city, broadly. We have not been able to narrow it further. It appears to move.

—

Of note: Two of our officers who were assigned to trace the signal reported disturbing dreams on the same night. Both described the same imagery independently: a city made of black glass under a sky with the wrong number of stars. Towers. Something moving in the towers.

Both officers were reassigned. Neither has spoken about it since.

—

Of additional note: The signal briefly intensified four days ago. The intensification coincided with the arrival of a vessel using Krrsh clearance codes. — Arrival record: [[connect: blacksand_downport]]

We are noting this correlation without drawing a conclusion.

We are watching.

roll_check.on_success: Deep Widow partition accessed. There is a signal. It noticed you arriving.
roll_check.on_failure: Partition locked. This file does not exist at your clearance level.

title: Widow Signals Division — Anomalous Source Triangulation
location: General Access Terminal — Blacksand Downport (Deep Partition)
author: Widow Administrative Office — Signals Division (Restricted)
content:
The Widow Signals Division has been tracking an unidentified repeating signal for approximately three months. The signal does not match any known protocol. It repeats at irregular intervals between nine and forty-three minutes.

The division has triangulation data from three prior attempts, each inconclusive. A fourth attempt using a selected sensor array may produce a more precise fix. Prior attempts have placed the source in the eastern lower city — [[connect: scrapheap]] district.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

lines: >> WIDOW SIGNALS DIVISION — TRIANGULATION INTERFACE v4.1
>> SIGNAL PROFILE: UNKNOWN — NOT IN ANY DATABASE

options: NORTH SPIRE RELAY — City upper tier coverage
SOUTH CANYON GRID — Lower city canyon coverage
SKULL ORBITAL UPLINK — Highest resolution, longest delay

steps.label: RUNNING TRIANGULATION — PLEASE WAIT FOR SIGNAL PULSE...

lines: >> SOURCE REGION: APPROX. 200M RADIUS — EASTERN SCRAPHEAP
>> CURRENT BEARING: MOVING — TOWARD LOWER CANYON
>> NOTE: SIGNAL BRIEFLY INTENSIFIED DURING TRIANGULATION.
>> NOTE: INTENSITY SPIKE CORRELATED WITH YOUR ACCESS OF THIS TERMINAL.
>> 'ONE OF OUR OFFICERS JUST REPORTED SEEING SOMETHING.'
>> 'HE HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO STAY WHERE HE IS.'
>> 'HE IS NOT STAYING WHERE HE IS.'

on_complete.message: The triangulation result sits on the screen: eastern Scrapheap, 200-metre radius, moving. The signal intensified the moment you accessed this terminal — it noticed the query. The Widow officer who went to investigate has stopped responding. The Scrapheap. The pre-Collapse hull. The warm surface. The coordinates from the hull's own terminal. And now a signal that moves, that responds to attention, that has been active in this city for three months — since before you arrived, but not by much.

on_failure.message: TRIANGULATION ABORTED. Signal went silent during the attempt — for the first time since it was first detected three months ago. The silence lasted exactly 4.3 seconds. Then it resumed. As if it had been listening.

title: Asharden Canteen Ledger — Locker Traffic Irregularities
author: Quartermaster Sel
content:
Locker rentals up 43% this week. Most are legitimate long-haul crews staging dry goods, but a cluster of short-term rentals (under two hours) now tracks with known courier windows from the Scrapheap and lower canyon gaming floor.

Two different crews used the same locker row on staggered timing and left without opening each other's compartments. Professional, careful, and very aware of camera angles.

[[redacted diff=9 skill="Recon" attempts=2]]
Locker 14 has a false rear panel leading to maintenance duct C-11. Route exits within walking distance of Kallos perimeter fence. Path is tight; armored travelers will jam it.[[/redacted]]

If this keeps up, camp will start charging "discretion fees."

title: Vii Lon — Departure Note
location: General Access Terminal — Asharden Camp, Upper City Edge
author: Vii Lon
content:
I am leaving the camp. I am filing this so that if the camp admin looks for me, they know I left voluntarily.

I received an offer of passage offworld from a party who has not given me their name. They left a note under my bunk. The note said to come to Tuk's bar at second bell and ask for the booth at the back. They said I should tell no one where I was going.

I am telling this terminal because I do not trust offers from nameless parties, and I believe that creating a record is the safest thing I can do.

What happened in that hotel room on Theev, before I came to the camp:

I was a commercial attaché for the Tobia Commerce Guild. We were in Room 15 of the Grand Hotel. There were four of us. I was in the bathroom when whoever it was came through the door. By the time I came out, the other three were dead. I did not see who did it.

I know what they were carrying. A sealed data chip. Contract documentation for a recovery job in deep Reach space — materials of unknown origin, acquired from a derelict. The chip detailed the recovery site coordinates.

I don't have the chip. It was in Revan's bag. Revan is dead. The chip may have gone with whoever came through the door.

I don't know who wanted it. I don't know if the passage offer tonight is from someone who wants to help me or from someone who wants to make sure I can't tell anyone else what I just wrote.

If you're reading this and I don't come back:
Tuk's bar. Second bell. Booth at the back.

For the blood gang incident: [[connect: lower_city]]

title: Offworld Contract — Applicant Screening Notes
location: General Access Terminal — Asharden Camp, Upper City Edge
author: Camp Administrator — Personal Notes (Private Partition)

roll_check.on_success: Administrator's private screening notes accessed. The contract poster isn't who you'd expect.
roll_check.on_failure: Private partition locked. Administrator's personal notes require elevated clearance.

content:
PRIVATE NOTES — OFFWORLD CONTRACT APPLICANT SCREENING — MY RECORD, NOT FOR CAMP USE

The contract was posted eight days ago. Cr 40,000 plus fuel, one-week job, ship required, no passengers. The poster was a woman, late forties, short hair, very expensive civilian clothes over what I spent enough years in the Imperial Scouts to recognize as a military posture. She did not give a name.

She paid the posting fee in old Imperial currency — physical coins, pre-Collapse minting. I did not ask about this.

Applicants so far:
— Three independent operators, all declined after screening. Reasons given: job scope unclear, destination unknown, one crew asked about the destination and was told only 'outer Reach, uncharted approach.' They declined.
— One crew that arrived via Krrsh clearance codes. They did not apply formally. They came to the admin booth and asked questions. They were professional and careful. The woman who posted the contract watched them from across the hall and did not approach them. She came back afterward and asked me what they had wanted. I told her. She nodded and said 'that's the one.'

I do not know what this means. I filed it because I believe in records.

The posting woman is staying somewhere in the upper city. She dresses well enough for the Grand Hotel. She has not left a contact address. She checks the posting board every morning at 0730.

For the contract board posting: [[log: Asharden Camp — Intake Notice]]

title: Anonymous Research Post — Black Glass Properties
location: General Access Terminal — Asharden Camp, Upper City Edge
author: Anonymous — Proxy Account
content:
A series of queries has been posted to the camp's public board over the last three months under a proxy account. The questions are technical and specific. The account has never responded to replies. The proxy routing origin is masked.

The queries concern the same subject: recovered mineral samples with anomalous thermal and mass properties.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

lines: >> ASHARDEN CAMP — COMMUNITY BOARD ARCHIVE v1.2
>> ACADEMIC VOCABULARY: CONSISTENT WITH XENOGRAPHIC MATERIALS SCIENCE

steps.label: TRACING PROXY CHAIN — STRIPPING HOP HEADERS...

lines: >> HOP 1: BLACKSAND CITY — CLIFF DISTRICT RELAY
>> TERMS USED: 'ANOMALOUS THERMAL SIGNATURE', 'INVERSE MASS GRADIENT',
>> PUBLISHED PAPERS USING SAME TERMS: 3 — ALL CLASSIFIED AFTER PUBLICATION
>> NOTE: BAY 6 VESSEL DOCKED 3 DAYS AGO.
>> NOTE: FIRST QUERY POST: 3 MONTHS AGO.
>> NOTE: MOST RECENT QUERY: 2 DAYS BEFORE BAY 6 VESSEL ARRIVED.

on_complete.message: The vocabulary is GeDeCo. The lab vessel in Bay 6 arrived three days ago. The queries started three months ago — someone at GeDeCo has been quietly asking around this camp's community board about black glass artifacts for months before they sent a ship. They know something is here, or was here, or passed through here. The proxy routing through the Cliff District relay means someone on-planet placed the queries — someone who was already here long before the ship arrived.

on_failure.message: PROXY TRACE FAILED. All four hop headers have been stripped — someone used a purpose-built anonymisation chain, not an off-the-shelf relay. The origin is unrecoverable. The queries remain, and the vocabulary remains, but there is no way to confirm who sent them.
